say:1:1721231001:1.text: Magister Merlin, we've got what we need. It's time to close the case.
say:1:1721231001:1.source_cn: 梅林阁下，案件的全貌已经梳理清楚。是时候结案了。
say:1:1721231001:1.male: Magister Merlin, we've got what we need. It's time to close the case.
say:1:1721231001:1.female: Magister Merlin, we've got what we need. It's time to close the case.

say:2:1721231002:1.text: Count Ramir defrauded Baron Grandet for profit, took bribes in the sale of titles, and exploited His Majesty's illness in the process—an act that amounts to an offense against the court. His accomplice will be treated as a lesser offender.
say:2:1721231002:1.source_cn: 拉米尔伯爵实施诈骗罪，非法受贿买卖爵位；为了牟利，借陛...
say:2:1721231002:1.male: Count Ramir defrauded Baron Grandet for profit, took bribes in the sale of titles, and exploited His Majesty's illness in the process—an act that amounts to an offense against the court. His accomplice will be treated as a lesser offender.
say:2:1721231002:1.female: Count Ramir defrauded Baron Grandet for profit, took bribes in the sale of titles, and exploited His Majesty's illness in the process—an act that amounts to an offense against the court. His accomplice will be treated as a lesser offender.

say:5:1721231004:1.text: Understood. The two offenders will remain in custody, and Baron Grandet will be released without charge.
say:5:1721231004:1.source_cn: 是。那么，两名犯人就交由守备军收押，葛朗台男爵以无罪释放。
say:5:1721231004:1.male: Understood. The two offenders will remain in custody, and Baron Grandet will be released without charge.
say:5:1721231004:1.female: Understood. The two offenders will remain in custody, and Baron Grandet will be released without charge.

narration:6:1721231005:1.text: And with that, the neon carp fraud case is officially closed. But as Grandet trudges out in misery, another surprise is waiting for him at the entrance...

narration:7:1721231006:1.text: Of course, it isn't just any surprise. It's the very same crowd of reporters he invited to witness his grand presentation of the so-called miracle fish.

choice:4:0:1.text: He should be found not guilty.
choice:4:0:1.male: He should be found not guilty.
choice:4:0:1.female: He should be found not guilty.

choice:4:1:2.text: Whatever his faults, he was the victim here.
choice:4:1:2.male: Whatever his faults, he was the victim here.
choice:4:1:2.female: Whatever his faults, he was the victim here.
